description: When to record, and how data is split into files. Loggers have no button: recording starts automatically after power-on unless the master is connected (it's in control then) or configured otherwise, and can be started or stopped remotely.

autostart.description: Start recording automatically after power-on, when not connected to the master (see autostart_with_master).

autostart_with_master.description: Also auto-start when connected to the master. Default false: with the master connected, recording waits for a start command. The countdown waits up to 30 s extra while WiFi has joined but MQTT isn't connected yet, and is cancelled if the master connects before it ends.

session.description: Session name for new recordings (FILE_FORMAT.md, Sessions). Empty: named after the start time, or 'unnamed' if the clock isn't set.

flush_interval_s.description: Maximum data lost on a power cut.

sinks.description: Where recorded data goes. Default (null): every sink this logger has; a logger without an SD card simply has no sd sink. usb streams DLOG over the USB serial port (bench use).

autostart.description: counting: countdown running; waiting_for_master: countdown over, waiting to see whether the master connects; skipped_master: cancelled because the master is connected; started: auto-start ran; resuming / resumed: it was recording when it last stopped running (reset, flat battery, reboot), so it carries on after the countdown whether or not the master is connected; off: autostart disabled, or recording was started/stopped by command.

session.description: Session being recorded (or that the next recording will use).

countdown_s.description: Seconds until auto-start, while counting down.

started_ms.description: UTC ms when recording started, or null if unsynced.

start.description: Start recording now (opens a new file). Cancels any countdown. If session is given it's stored as recording.session, and an ongoing recording rolls to a new file in that session.

stop.description: Stop recording (writes END and closes the file). Lasts until the next power-on.

roll_file.description: Close the current file and open the next.

events.autostart_skipped: Auto-start was cancelled because the master is connected.
events.file_rolled: A new data file was opened.
